# Asendus Implementation Plan

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED: Use superpowers-extended-cc:subagent-driven-development (if subagents available) or superpowers-extended-cc:executing-plans to implement this plan. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** A web app where Aili uploads the school's aSc teacher-timetable PDF, marks absent teachers for a date, picks eligible substitutes per lesson, and copies or prints the day's substitution table.

**Architecture:** A Spring Boot API (generated by the `spring-boot-api-starter` skill) parses the PDF with PDFBox, stores versioned timetables and substitutions in Postgres, and computes eligibility with a pure function. A Vite + React SPA in `web/` signs in with Google (ID token → API JWT), with a public landing page and protected pages. The API deploys to the VPS via Docker/Traefik; the web app deploys to Cloudflare Pages.

**Tech Stack:** Java 25, Spring Boot 4, Maven, Postgres 17, Flyway, Apache PDFBox 3, JUnit 5 + Testcontainers; React 19 + TypeScript + Vite, react-router 7, @tanstack/react-query 5, @react-oauth/google, Tailwind CSS 4, Vitest.

**Spec:** `docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-14-asendus-design.md`. Read it first.

**Conventions (from the starter, keep them):**
- Package `com.asendus.api`. Context path `/api/v1`, but MockMvc paths are written without it (e.g. `get("/me")`).
- Errors: throw `ResponseStatusException(status, "message")`; the handler renders `{ "error": "..." }`.
- Integration tests extend `IntegrationTest` (Testcontainers Postgres, shared context). Boot 4 imports: `org.springframework.boot.webmvc.test.autoconfigure.AutoConfigureMockMvc`, `@MockitoBean`, Jackson 3 is `tools.jackson.*`.
- Run Maven with `JAVA_HOME=/opt/homebrew/opt/openjdk@25` (the default Java is 21). Docker must be running.
- Commits: always go through the `commit` skill. Subject capitalised, ≥3 words; last body line `Changelog: Feature|Fix|Refactor|Chore`; no Co-authored-by.
- Never edit an applied migration; add `V3__...` etc.
- User-facing text is Estonian.

```java
@Bean
CorsConfigurationSource corsConfigurationSource(@Value("${app.cors.allowed-origins}") List<String> origins) {
    CorsConfiguration config = new CorsConfiguration();
    config.setAllowedOrigins(origins);
    config.setAllowedMethods(List.of("GET", "POST", "PUT", "DELETE", "OPTIONS"));
    config.setAllowedHeaders(List.of("Authorization", "Content-Type"));
    UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource source = new UrlBasedCorsConfigurationSource();
    source.registerCorsConfiguration("/**", config);
    return source;
}
```

```java
                PDFTextStripper s = new PDFTextStripper() {
                    @Override

                        System.out.printf("p%d x=%.1f-%.1f y=%.1f size=%.1f '%s'%n", getCurrentPageNo(),

                s.getText(doc);

    }
}
```

```java
static void dumpPaths(PDDocument doc, int pageIndex) throws IOException {
    var page = doc.getPage(pageIndex);
    new org.apache.pdfbox.contentstream.PDFGraphicsStreamEngine(page) {
        java.awt.geom.Point2D cur;
        @Override public void appendRectangle(java.awt.geom.Point2D p0, java.awt.geom.Point2D p1, java.awt.geom.Point2D p2, java.awt.geom.Point2D p3) {
            System.out.printf("rect %.1f,%.1f %.1f,%.1f%n", p0.getX(), p0.getY(), p2.getX(), p2.getY());
        }
        @Override public void moveTo(float x, float y) { cur = new java.awt.geom.Point2D.Float(x, y); }
        @Override public void lineTo(float x, float y) { System.out.printf("line %.1f,%.1f -> %.1f,%.1f%n", cur.getX(), cur.getY(), x, y); cur = new java.awt.geom.Point2D.Float(x, y); }
        @Override public void drawImage(org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.graphics.image.PDImage pdImage) {}
        @Override public void clip(int windingRule) {}
        @Override public void curveTo(float x1, float y1, float x2, float y2, float x3, float y3) {}
        @Override public java.awt.geom.Point2D getCurrentPoint() { return cur; }
        @Override public void closePath() {}
        @Override public void endPath() {}
        @Override public void strokePath() {}
        @Override public void fillPath(int windingRule) {}
        @Override public void fillAndStrokePath(int windingRule) {}
        @Override public void shadingFill(org.apache.pdfbox.cos.COSName shadingName) {}
    }.processPage(page);
}
```
Note: path coordinates have their origin at the bottom-left, while `getYDirAdj()` measures from the top. Convert with `pageHeight - y` before comparing.

```java
package com.asendus.api.timetable;

import java.text.Normalizer;
import java.util.Locale;

/** A teacher's identity across timetable versions is their normalized name. */
public final class TeacherKey {
    private TeacherKey() {}

    public static String of(String name) {
        return Normalizer.normalize(name, Normalizer.Form.NFC)
                .trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ").toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    }

    /** aSc prints "Surname Firstname(s)"; tables use "Firstname(s) Surname". */
    public static String displayName(String ascName) {
        String n = Normalizer.normalize(ascName, Normalizer.Form.NFC).trim().replaceAll("\\s+", " ");
        int space = n.indexOf(' ');
        return space < 0 ? n : n.substring(space + 1) + " " + n.substring(0, space);
    }
}
```

```java
package com.asendus.api.timetable;

import java.util.List;

public record ParsedTimetable(List<ParsedTeacher> teachers, List<String> warnings) {

    public record ParsedTeacher(String name, List<ParsedLesson> lessons) {}

    /** weekday 1 = Monday … 5 = Friday; period 1–7. classes/subject/room/note may be empty strings. */
    public record ParsedLesson(int weekday, int period, String classes, String subject, String room, String note) {}
}
```

### Task 4: TimetablePdfParser

The approach below matches what the spec and the sample PDFs showed. Adapt the thresholds to the measurements in the Task 2 notes.

**Algorithm (per page):**
1. Collect words: `writeString` gives text runs; split each run on gaps wider than ~2× the average char width into `PdfWord(text, x0, x1, y, size)`.
2. Title: the word(s) with the largest font in the top band that start with "Õpetaja " → name = rest of line. A page without "Õpetaja" title or without all column numbers 1–7 → warning "Lk N: ei tundu õpetaja tunniplaanina", skip the page.
3. Grid: column header words `1`…`7` (same font size, same y) → `colCenter[p]`. Column width `w = colCenter[2]-colCenter[1]`. Day labels `Es Te Ko Ne Re` → `rowCenter[d]`, row height `h`. Ignore header/time/title/footer words (everything above the first row top, or below the last row bottom, or left of column 1's left edge).
4. Every remaining word belongs to row `d` (nearest row center) and to the x-range it covers.
5. **Large words** (font ≥ the class-text threshold from the notes) are class text. **Small words** are labels: in the top 30% of the cell, left half → subject; right half → room; elsewhere → note.
6. **Double lesson:** a large word whose center lies within `0.15·w` of the boundary between periods p and p+1 covers both periods. Its labels (subject at the left of p, room at the right of p+1) are assigned to it.
7. Inside one slot, the subject labels (by y) split the slot into lessons: each lesson takes the large lines below its subject label and above the next subject label, plus the nearest room on the same line as its subject label and the notes below its class lines. No subject label → the whole slot is one lesson (subject ""). Lines of class text for one lesson are joined, then normalized: remove spaces; join lines with `/` unless the previous line already ends with `/`.
8. A slot that has only small text (e.g. Reinaru "3.kl ek õa") still becomes a lesson with classes "" and the text as note. The teacher is busy then.
9. Duplicate teacher keys in one file → second becomes `"<name> (2)"`, plus a warning.

```java
import java.util.List;

import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat;
import static org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThatThrownBy;

class TimetablePdfParserTest {

    static ParsedTimetable b;

    @BeforeAll
    static void parse() {
        b = new TimetablePdfParser().parse(TestPdfs.load("opetajad-b.pdf"));
    }

    static ParsedTeacher teacher(String name) {
        return b.teachers().stream().filter(t -> t.name().equals(name)).findFirst().orElseThrow();
    }

    static List<ParsedLesson> at(String name, int weekday, int period) {
        return teacher(name).lessons().stream().filter(l -> l.weekday() == weekday && l.period() == period).toList();
    }

    @Test
    void readsEveryTeacherPage() {
        assertThat(b.teachers()).hasSize(46);
        assertThat(b.teachers().getFirst().name()).isEqualTo("Bondar Julia");
        assertThat(b.warnings()).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void readsASimpleCell() {
        // Pärnpuu Taimi, Monday period 1: Ek, room 221, class 4R
        assertThat(at("Pärnpuu Taimi", 1, 1)).containsExactly(new ParsedLesson(1, 1, "4R", "Ek", "221", ""));
        // Friday period 4: Aj 6R
        assertThat(at("Pärnpuu Taimi", 5, 4)).extracting(ParsedLesson::subject, ParsedLesson::classes).containsExactly(org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("Aj", "6R"));
        assertThat(at("Pärnpuu Taimi", 1, 5)).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void readsGroupNotesAndMultiClassText() {
        assertThat(at("Pärnpuu Taimi", 1, 3)).singleElement().satisfies(l -> {
            assertThat(l.classes()).isEqualTo("4R/4M/4S");
            assertThat(l.note()).isEqualTo("Grupp 1/grupp 1/grupp 1");
        });
        // three stacked lines in one cell
        assertThat(at("Moora Piret", 3, 1)).singleElement()
                .extracting(ParsedLesson::classes).isEqualTo("2.3/2.4/2.5/2.3V/2.5V");
    }

    @Test
    void splitsADoubleLessonIntoTwoPeriods() {
        // Pupart Krista, Tuesday: "5R" spans periods 1–2, TÕ room 017
        assertThat(at("Pupart Krista", 2, 1)).extracting(ParsedLesson::classes, ParsedLesson::subject, ParsedLesson::room)
                .containsExactly(org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("5R", "TÕ", "017"));
        assertThat(at("Pupart Krista", 2, 2)).extracting(ParsedLesson::classes).containsExactly("5R");
        assertThat(at("Pupart Krista", 2, 3)).extracting(ParsedLesson::classes).containsExactly("5D");
        // Thursday 6–7 "5M/5MV"
        assertThat(at("Pupart Krista", 4, 7)).extracting(ParsedLesson::classes).containsExactly("5M/5MV");
    }

    @Test
    void splitsASplitCellIntoTwoLessons() {
        // Ambos Algi, Thursday period 5: 6M (219) and 6R (217)
        assertThat(at("Ambos Algi", 4, 5)).extracting(ParsedLesson::classes, ParsedLesson::room)
                .containsExactlyInAnyOrder(org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("6M", "219"), org.assertj.core.groups.Tuple.tuple("6R", "217"));
    }

    @Test
    void keepsEmptyAndNoteOnlyTeachers() {
        assertThat(teacher("Malken Mariliis").lessons()).isEmpty();
        assertThat(at("Reinaru Tiia", 1, 2)).singleElement().satisfies(l -> {
            assertThat(l.classes()).isEmpty();
            assertThat(l.note()).isEqualTo("3.kl ek õa");
        });
    }

    @Test
    void readsMultiWordRooms() {
        assertThat(at("Illak Pille- Riin", 1, 1)).extracting(ParsedLesson::room).containsExactly("Mäe 212");
    }

    @ParameterizedTest
    @ValueSource(strings = {"opetajad-a.pdf", "opetajad-0304.pdf"})
    void parsesTheOtherSamplesWithoutWarnings(String file) {
        ParsedTimetable t = new TimetablePdfParser().parse(TestPdfs.load(file));
        assertThat(t.teachers()).isNotEmpty();
        assertThat(t.warnings()).isEmpty();
    }

    @Test
    void rejectsANonTimetablePdf() throws Exception {
        try (var doc = new org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument(); var out = new java.io.ByteArrayOutputStream()) {
            doc.addPage(new org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDPage());
            doc.save(out);
            assertThatThrownBy(() -> new TimetablePdfParser().parse(out.toByteArray()))
                    .isInstanceOf(TimetablePdfParser.NotATimetableException.class);
        }
    }
}
```

```java
package com.asendus.api.timetable;

import com.asendus.api.timetable.ParsedTimetable.ParsedLesson;
import com.asendus.api.timetable.ParsedTimetable.ParsedTeacher;
import org.apache.pdfbox.Loader;
import org.apache.pdfbox.pdmodel.PDDocument;
import org.apache.pdfbox.text.PDFTextStripper;
import org.apache.pdfbox.text.TextPosition;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Component;

import java.io.IOException;
import java.util.*;

/** Reads the aSc "õpetajad" PDF export: one page per teacher, 5 day rows × 7 period columns. */
@Component
public class TimetablePdfParser {

    // Set these from docs/superpowers/notes/2026-10-14-pdf-layout.md
    static final float CLASS_TEXT_MIN_SIZE = 14f;
    static final float DOUBLE_LESSON_TOLERANCE = 0.15f;
    static final List<String> DAYS = List.of("Es", "Te", "Ko", "Ne", "Re");

    public static class NotATimetableException extends RuntimeException {
        public NotATimetableException(String message) { super(message); }
    }

    public ParsedTimetable parse(byte[] pdf) {
        List<ParsedTeacher> teachers = new ArrayList<>();
        List<String> warnings = new ArrayList<>();
        Set<String> keys = new HashSet<>();

        try (PDDocument doc = Loader.loadPDF(pdf)) {
            for (int page = 1; page <= doc.getNumberOfPages(); page++) {
                List<PdfWord> words = words(doc, page);
                Optional<ParsedTeacher> teacher = parsePage(words, page, warnings);
                if (teacher.isEmpty()) continue;

                ParsedTeacher t = teacher.get();
                if (!keys.add(TeacherKey.of(t.name()))) {
                    String renamed = t.name() + " (2)";
                    warnings.add("Lk " + page + ": õpetaja \"" + t.name() + "\" on topelt, nimetatud \"" + renamed + "\"");
                    keys.add(TeacherKey.of(renamed));
                    t = new ParsedTeacher(renamed, t.lessons());
                }
                teachers.add(t);
            }
        } catch (IOException e) {
            throw new NotATimetableException("Faili ei õnnestunud PDF-ina lugeda");
        }

        if (teachers.isEmpty()) {
            throw new NotATimetableException("See ei tundu olevat aSc õpetajate tunniplaan");
        }
        return new ParsedTimetable(teachers, warnings);
    }

    private List<PdfWord> words(PDDocument doc, int page) throws IOException {
        List<PdfWord> out = new ArrayList<>();
        PDFTextStripper stripper = new PDFTextStripper() {
            @Override
            protected void writeString(String text, List<TextPosition> ps) {
                splitOnGaps(ps, out);
            }
        };
        stripper.setSortByPosition(true);
        stripper.setStartPage(page);
        stripper.setEndPage(page);
        stripper.getText(doc);
        return out;
    }

    /** A text run can hold several cells' words ("Ek  217"); split where the gap is wide. */
    private static void splitOnGaps(List<TextPosition> ps, List<PdfWord> out) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        TextPosition first = null, prev = null;
        for (TextPosition p : ps) {
            boolean gap = prev != null
                    && p.getXDirAdj() - (prev.getXDirAdj() + prev.getWidthDirAdj()) > 2.5f * Math.max(prev.getWidthDirAdj(), 1f);
            if (gap) {
                emit(sb, first, prev, out);
                sb.setLength(0);
                first = null;
            }
            if (first == null) first = p;
            sb.append(p.getUnicode());
            prev = p;
        }
        if (first != null) emit(sb, first, prev, out);
    }

    private static void emit(StringBuilder sb, TextPosition first, TextPosition last, List<PdfWord> out) {
        String text = sb.toString().trim();
        if (text.isEmpty()) return;
        out.add(new PdfWord(text, first.getXDirAdj(), last.getXDirAdj() + last.getWidthDirAdj(),
                first.getYDirAdj(), first.getFontSizeInPt()));
    }

    private Optional<ParsedTeacher> parsePage(List<PdfWord> words, int page, List<String> warnings) {
        Optional<PdfWord> title = words.stream()
                .filter(w -> w.text().startsWith("Õpetaja "))
                .max(Comparator.comparing(PdfWord::size));
        Map<Integer, PdfWord> cols = new HashMap<>();
        Map<Integer, PdfWord> rows = new HashMap<>();
        for (PdfWord w : words) {
            if (w.text().matches("[1-7]") && !cols.containsKey(Integer.parseInt(w.text()))) cols.put(Integer.parseInt(w.text()), w);
            int d = DAYS.indexOf(w.text());
            if (d >= 0 && w.size() >= CLASS_TEXT_MIN_SIZE) rows.put(d + 1, w);
        }
        if (title.isEmpty() || cols.size() < 7 || rows.size() < 5) {
            warnings.add("Lk " + page + ": ei tundu õpetaja tunniplaanina, jäeti vahele");
            return Optional.empty();
        }

        Grid grid = new Grid(cols, rows);
        String name = title.get().text().substring("Õpetaja ".length()).trim();
        Set<PdfWord> header = new HashSet<>(cols.values());
        header.addAll(rows.values());
        header.add(title.get());

        // slot (weekday, period) → words in it
        Map<Slot, List<PdfWord>> slots = new TreeMap<>();
        for (PdfWord w : words) {
            if (header.contains(w) || !grid.inside(w)) continue;
            int day = grid.row(w);
            for (int period : grid.periods(w)) {
                slots.computeIfAbsent(new Slot(day, period), k -> new ArrayList<>()).add(w);
            }
        }

        List<ParsedLesson> lessons = new ArrayList<>();
        slots.forEach((slot, ws) -> lessons.addAll(lessonsIn(slot, ws, grid)));
        return Optional.of(new ParsedTeacher(name, lessons));
    }

    private record Slot(int weekday, int period) implements Comparable<Slot> {
        public int compareTo(Slot o) { return weekday != o.weekday ? weekday - o.weekday : period - o.period; }
    }

    private List<ParsedLesson> lessonsIn(Slot slot, List<PdfWord> ws, Grid grid) {
        float top = grid.rowTop(slot.weekday());
        float labelBand = top + grid.rowHeight * 0.3f;
        float mid = grid.colCenter(slot.period());

        List<PdfWord> big = ws.stream().filter(w -> w.size() >= CLASS_TEXT_MIN_SIZE).sorted(Comparator.comparing(PdfWord::y)).toList();
        List<PdfWord> small = ws.stream().filter(w -> w.size() < CLASS_TEXT_MIN_SIZE).toList();
        // A double lesson's labels sit in neighbouring columns: decide left/right by the word's own span, not the slot center
        List<PdfWord> subjects = new ArrayList<>(), rooms = new ArrayList<>(), notes = new ArrayList<>();
        for (PdfWord w : small) {
            boolean labelRow = big.isEmpty() ? isLabelRow(w, ws) : big.stream().anyMatch(b -> w.y() < b.y() - b.size() * 0.5f && b.y() - w.y() < grid.rowHeight * 0.45f);
            if (!labelRow) notes.add(w);
            else if (w.cx() < (grid.periodsLeft(w) + grid.periodsRight(w)) / 2 && !w.text().matches("\\d{3}|.*\\d{3}$")) subjects.add(w);
            else rooms.add(w);
        }
        subjects.sort(Comparator.comparing(PdfWord::y));

        if (big.isEmpty()) {
            String note = String.join(" ", small.stream().sorted(Comparator.comparing(PdfWord::y).thenComparing(PdfWord::x0)).map(PdfWord::text).toList());
            String room = rooms.isEmpty() ? "" : rooms.getFirst().text();
            return List.of(new ParsedLesson(slot.weekday(), slot.period(), "",
                    subjects.isEmpty() ? "" : subjects.getFirst().text(), room,
                    note.replace(room, "").trim()));
        }

        List<ParsedLesson> out = new ArrayList<>();
        int parts = Math.max(1, subjects.size());
        for (int i = 0; i < parts; i++) {
            float from = subjects.isEmpty() ? Float.NEGATIVE_INFINITY : subjects.get(i).y();
            float to = i + 1 < subjects.size() ? subjects.get(i + 1).y() : Float.POSITIVE_INFINITY;
            List<PdfWord> cls = big.stream().filter(w -> w.y() > from && w.y() < to).toList();
            String subject = subjects.isEmpty() ? "" : subjects.get(i).text();
            String room = rooms.stream().filter(r -> r.y() >= from - 1 && r.y() < to).map(PdfWord::text).findFirst().orElse("");
            String note = String.join(" ", notes.stream().filter(n -> n.y() > from && n.y() < to).map(PdfWord::text).toList());
            out.add(new ParsedLesson(slot.weekday(), slot.period(), joinClasses(cls), subject, room, note));
        }
        return out;
    }

    private static boolean isLabelRow(PdfWord w, List<PdfWord> all) {
        return all.stream().allMatch(o -> o.y() >= w.y() - 1);
    }

    /** "2.3/2.4", "2.5/2.3V", "2.5V" → "2.3/2.4/2.5/2.3V/2.5V"; "2.3/2.4/" + "2.5" → "2.3/2.4/2.5". */
    static String joinClasses(List<PdfWord> lines) {
        StringBuilder sb = new StringBuilder();
        for (PdfWord w : lines) {
            String t = w.text().replace(" ", "");
            if (!sb.isEmpty() && sb.charAt(sb.length() - 1) != '/') sb.append('/');
            sb.append(t);
        }
        return sb.toString();
    }

    /** Column/row geometry of one page. */
    private static final class Grid {
        final float[] colCenters = new float[8];
        final float[] rowCenters = new float[6];
        final float colWidth, rowHeight;

        Grid(Map<Integer, PdfWord> cols, Map<Integer, PdfWord> rows) {
            for (int p = 1; p <= 7; p++) colCenters[p] = cols.get(p).cx();
            for (int d = 1; d <= 5; d++) rowCenters[d] = rows.get(d).y();
            colWidth = (colCenters[7] - colCenters[1]) / 6;
            rowHeight = (rowCenters[5] - rowCenters[1]) / 4;
        }

        float colCenter(int p) { return colCenters[p]; }
        float rowTop(int d) { return rowCenters[d] - rowHeight / 2; }

        boolean inside(PdfWord w) {
            return w.x0() >= colCenters[1] - colWidth / 2 - 2 && w.x1() <= colCenters[7] + colWidth / 2 + 2
                    && w.y() >= rowTop(1) && w.y() <= rowCenters[5] + rowHeight / 2;
        }

        int row(PdfWord w) {
            int best = 1;
            for (int d = 2; d <= 5; d++) if (Math.abs(w.y() - rowCenters[d]) < Math.abs(w.y() - rowCenters[best])) best = d;
            // Words sit below the row's label baseline; nearest-center works because labels are vertically centered
            return best;
        }

        /** The periods a word belongs to: one normally; two when its center sits on a column boundary (double lesson). */
        List<Integer> periods(PdfWord w) {
            for (int p = 1; p < 7; p++) {
                float boundary = colCenters[p] + colWidth / 2;
                if (w.size() >= CLASS_TEXT_MIN_SIZE && Math.abs(w.cx() - boundary) < colWidth * DOUBLE_LESSON_TOLERANCE) {
                    return List.of(p, p + 1);
                }
            }
            int p = (int) Math.floor((w.cx() - (colCenters[1] - colWidth / 2)) / colWidth) + 1;
            return List.of(Math.clamp(p, 1, 7));
        }

        float periodsLeft(PdfWord w) { int p = periods(w).getFirst(); return colCenters[p] - colWidth / 2; }
        float periodsRight(PdfWord w) { int p = periods(w).getLast(); return colCenters[p] + colWidth / 2; }
    }
}
```

**Known gap the tests will expose:** a double lesson's subject label ("TÕ" at the left of period 1) and room ("017" at the right of period 2) each land in only one slot, so period 2's lesson has no subject. Fix in this step: after building all lessons for a page, for each pair of lessons at (d, p) and (d, p+1) whose classes come from the **same** large word (track the source `PdfWord` in an internal record before converting to `ParsedLesson`), merge the labels so both periods get the same subject, room and note. Keep the code readable: introduce an internal `RawLesson(Slot slot, PdfWord source, String classes, String subject, String room, String note)` and convert to `ParsedLesson` at the end.

Iterate on thresholds until all tests in Step 1 pass. Keep each helper small. If `TimetablePdfParser` grows past ~250 lines, move `Grid` into its own package-private file.

```java
package com.asendus.api.substitution;

public enum Availability { FREE, ASK_FIRST, HIDDEN }
```

```java
package com.asendus.api.substitution;

import java.util.Collections;
import java.util.Set;

/** Can a teacher cover period p? Only timetable lessons define the working day; taken substitutions don't extend it. */
public final class Eligibility {
    private Eligibility() {}

    /**
     * @param lessonPeriods periods the teacher teaches that weekday
     * @param blocked       absent in p, already substituting in p, or a placeholder
     */
    public static Availability of(Set<Integer> lessonPeriods, int period, boolean blocked) {
        if (blocked || lessonPeriods.isEmpty() || lessonPeriods.contains(period)) return Availability.HIDDEN;
        int first = Collections.min(lessonPeriods);
        int last = Collections.max(lessonPeriods);
        if ((period > first && period < last) || period == last + 1) return Availability.FREE;
        if (period == first - 1) return Availability.ASK_FIRST;
        return Availability.HIDDEN;
    }
}
```

```sql
CREATE TABLE timetable_version (
    id          BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    uploaded_at TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    uploaded_by BIGINT      NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id),
    file_name   TEXT        NOT NULL,
    active      BOOLEAN     NOT NULL DEFAULT FALSE,
    warnings    TEXT[]      NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}'
);
-- At most one active version
CREATE UNIQUE INDEX timetable_version_one_active ON timetable_version (active) WHERE active;

CREATE TABLE teacher (
    id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    version_id BIGINT NOT NULL REFERENCES timetable_version (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    key        TEXT   NOT NULL,
    name       TEXT   NOT NULL,
    UNIQUE (version_id, key)
);

CREATE TABLE lesson (
    id         BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    teacher_id BIGINT   NOT NULL REFERENCES teacher (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    weekday    SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (weekday BETWEEN 1 AND 5),
    period     SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (period BETWEEN 1 AND 7),
    classes    TEXT     NOT NULL,
    subject    TEXT     NOT NULL,
    room       TEXT     NOT NULL,
    note       TEXT     NOT NULL
);
CREATE INDEX lesson_teacher_day ON lesson (teacher_id, weekday);

CREATE TABLE placeholder_flag (
    teacher_key TEXT PRIMARY KEY
);

CREATE TABLE absence (
    id           BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    date         DATE     NOT NULL,
    teacher_key  TEXT     NOT NULL,
    teacher_name TEXT     NOT NULL,
    from_period  SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (from_period BETWEEN 1 AND 7),
    to_period    SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (to_period BETWEEN 1 AND 7),
    created_by   BIGINT   NOT NULL REFERENCES app_user (id),
    created_at   TIMESTAMPTZ NOT NULL DEFAULT now(),
    UNIQUE (date, teacher_key),
    CHECK (from_period <= to_period)
);

CREATE TABLE substitution (
    id               BIGSERIAL PRIMARY KEY,
    absence_id       BIGINT   NOT NULL REFERENCES absence (id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
    period           SMALLINT NOT NULL CHECK (period BETWEEN 1 AND 7),
    classes          TEXT     NOT NULL,
    subject          TEXT     NOT NULL,
    substitute_keys  TEXT[]   NOT NULL DEFAULT '{}',
    substitute_names TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
    free_text        TEXT     NOT NULL DEFAULT ''
);
CREATE INDEX substitution_absence ON substitution (absence_id);
```

- [ ] **Step 2: Entities** (Lombok style like `AppUser`: `@Entity @Getter @Setter @NoArgsConstructor @AllArgsConstructor @Builder`, `GenerationType.IDENTITY`).

- `TimetableVersion`: `id`, `uploadedAt` (`@CreationTimestamp Instant`), `uploadedBy` (`Long`), `fileName`, `active`, `warnings` (`@JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.ARRAY) @Column(columnDefinition = "text[]") List<String>`; a plain text array avoids Hibernate's JSON mapper needing Jackson 2).
- `Teacher`: `id`, `versionId` (`Long`), `teacherKey` (`@Column(name = "key")`), `name`. (`key` and `date` are HQL keywords, so the Java fields avoid them.) (Plain FK ids, no JPA relations, to keep queries explicit.)
- `Lesson`: `id`, `teacherId`, `weekday` (`short`), `period` (`short`), `classes`, `subject`, `room`, `note`.
- `PlaceholderFlag`: `@Id String teacherKey`.
- `Absence`: `id`, `absenceDate` (`@Column(name = "date") LocalDate`), `teacherKey`, `teacherName`, `fromPeriod`, `toPeriod` (`short`), `createdBy`, `createdAt` (`@CreationTimestamp`).
- `Substitution`: `id`, `absenceId`, `period` (`short`), `classes`, `subject`, `substituteKeys` (`@JdbcTypeCode(SqlTypes.ARRAY) @Column(columnDefinition = "text[]") List<String>`, default `new ArrayList<>()` with `@Builder.Default`), `substituteNames`, `freeText`.

Repositories (`JpaRepository<X, Long>` unless noted):
```java
interface TimetableVersionRepository { Optional<TimetableVersion> findByActiveTrue(); List<TimetableVersion> findByActiveFalse(); }
interface TeacherRepository { List<Teacher> findByVersionIdOrderByName(Long versionId); Optional<Teacher> findByVersionIdAndTeacherKey(Long versionId, String key); long countByVersionId(Long versionId); }
interface LessonRepository { List<Lesson> findByTeacherIdIn(Collection<Long> ids); List<Lesson> findByTeacherIdOrderByWeekdayAscPeriodAsc(Long teacherId); List<Lesson> findByTeacherIdInAndWeekday(Collection<Long> ids, short weekday); long countByTeacherIdIn(Collection<Long> ids); }
interface PlaceholderFlagRepository extends JpaRepository<PlaceholderFlag, String> {}
interface AbsenceRepository { List<Absence> findByAbsenceDateOrderByTeacherName(LocalDate date); boolean existsByAbsenceDateAndTeacherKey(LocalDate d, String key);
    @Query("select distinct a.absenceDate from Absence a order by a.absenceDate desc") List<LocalDate> findDistinctDates(); }
interface SubstitutionRepository { List<Substitution> findByAbsenceIdInOrderByPeriod(Collection<Long> absenceIds); }
```

Key methods (all `@Transactional`):
```java
public TimetablePreviewDto upload(String fileName, byte[] pdf, Long userId) {
    ParsedTimetable parsed;
    try { parsed = parser.parse(pdf); }
    catch (TimetablePdfParser.NotATimetableException e) { throw new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, e.getMessage()); }

    versionRepository.deleteAll(versionRepository.findByActiveFalse());   // cascades teachers/lessons
    TimetableVersion v = versionRepository.save(TimetableVersion.builder()
            .uploadedBy(userId).fileName(fileName).active(false).warnings(parsed.warnings()).build());
    for (ParsedTeacher pt : parsed.teachers()) {
        Teacher t = teacherRepository.save(Teacher.builder().versionId(v.getId()).teacherKey(TeacherKey.of(pt.name())).name(pt.name()).build());
        lessonRepository.saveAll(pt.lessons().stream().map(l -> Lesson.builder().teacherId(t.getId())
                .weekday((short) l.weekday()).period((short) l.period()).classes(l.classes())
                .subject(l.subject()).room(l.room()).note(l.note()).build()).toList());
    }
    return preview(v);
}

public TimetablePreviewDto activate(Long id) {
    TimetableVersion v = versionRepository.findById(id).orElseThrow(() -> new ResponseStatusException(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, "Tunniplaani ei leitud"));
    versionRepository.findByActiveTrue().ifPresent(old -> { old.setActive(false); versionRepository.saveAndFlush(old); });
    v.setActive(true);
    versionRepository.saveAndFlush(v);
    return preview(v);
}
```
Note: activation leaves the previous version in place (inactive). `upload` deletes inactive versions, which would include formerly active ones. That is fine: substitutions keep copies of the names and classes, and nothing references old versions.

`preview(v)`: counts via repositories; `added`/`removed` = key-set difference between `v` and the active version (excluding `v` itself), mapped to `TeacherKey.displayName(name)`, sorted.

`active()`: active version or 404 "Tunniplaan puudub"; teachers sorted by name with `placeholder = placeholderFlagRepository.existsById(key)` (load all flags once into a Set).

`grid(key)`: teacher in the active version or 404 "Õpetajat ei leitud"; lessons ordered by weekday, period.

`setPlaceholder(key, flag)`: save or delete `PlaceholderFlag(key)`.

### Task 8: Days, absences, candidates, substitutions

**Endpoints** (`DayController`, authenticated):
- `GET /days` → `["2026-10-14", …]` newest first
- `GET /days/{date}` → `DayDto`
- `POST /days/{date}/absences` `{teacherKey, fromPeriod?, toPeriod?}` → 201 `AbsenceDto`
- `DELETE /absences/{id}` → 204
- `GET /days/{date}/candidates?period=p` → `List<CandidateDto>`
- `PUT /substitutions/{id}` `{substituteKeys: [...], freeText: "..."}` → 200 `SubstitutionDto`

**DTOs (`DayDtos.java`):**
```java
public record SubstitutionDto(Long id, int period, String classes, String subject,
                              List<String> substituteKeys, String substituteNames, String freeText) {}
public record AbsenceDto(Long id, String teacherKey, String teacherName, int fromPeriod, int toPeriod, List<SubstitutionDto> rows) {}
public record DayDto(LocalDate date, int weekday, List<AbsenceDto> absences) {}
public record CreateAbsenceRequest(@NotBlank String teacherKey, @Min(1) @Max(7) Integer fromPeriod, @Min(1) @Max(7) Integer toPeriod) {}
public record CandidateDto(String key, String name, Availability status, List<String> subjects, int todayCount) {}
public record UpdateSubstitutionRequest(@NotNull List<String> substituteKeys, @NotNull String freeText) {}
```
`teacherName`, `name` and `substituteNames` use display names ("Taimi Pärnpuu"). `substituteNames` = display names joined with " / " in the order given.

**Rules:**
- weekday = `date.getDayOfWeek().getValue()`; 6–7 → 400 "Nädalavahetusel tunde pole" (on POST absence and GET candidates). `GET /days/{date}` on a weekend returns an empty day.
- POST absence: no active timetable → 409 "Lae esmalt tunniplaan üles". Unknown key → 404 "Õpetajat ei leitud". Duplicate → 409 "See õpetaja on juba puudujaks märgitud". `fromPeriod` defaults to 1, `toPeriod` to 7; from > to → 400. Rows = the teacher's lessons that weekday with `from ≤ period ≤ to`, one row per lesson, ordered by period (snapshot copies of classes/subject).
- Candidates for (date, p): every teacher of the active version except placeholders. `blocked` if absent in p that date (an absence with from ≤ p ≤ to) or already in `substituteKeys` of a row with period p on that date. Compute `Eligibility.of(lessonPeriods, p, blocked)`; drop HIDDEN. `subjects` = the teacher's distinct non-empty subject codes across the whole week, sorted. `todayCount` = number of distinct periods on that date where the teacher is in some row's `substituteKeys`. Sort: FREE before ASK_FIRST, then `todayCount` ascending, then display name.
- DELETE absence: unknown id → 404 "Puudujat ei leitud".
- PUT substitution: unknown id → 404. Every key must exist in the active version → else 400 "Tundmatu õpetaja". Set keys, names, trimmed freeText. (No re-check of eligibility: Aili may override the suggestions.)

```java
    /** Keys of teachers whose Friday lesson periods match the predicate, from the active timetable. */
    List<String> fridayTeachers(java.util.function.Predicate<java.util.Set<Integer>> match) {
        Map<String, java.util.Set<Integer>> periods = new java.util.TreeMap<>();
        jdbc.query("""
                select t.key, l.period from teacher t
                join timetable_version v on v.id = t.version_id and v.active
                left join lesson l on l.teacher_id = t.id and l.weekday = 5
                """, rs -> {
            var set = periods.computeIfAbsent(rs.getString(1), k -> new java.util.TreeSet<>());
            int p = rs.getInt(2);
            if (!rs.wasNull()) set.add(p);
        });
        return periods.entrySet().stream().filter(e -> match.test(e.getValue())).map(Map.Entry::getKey).toList();
    }

    String displayName(String key) {
        return TeacherKey.displayName(jdbc.queryForObject(
                "select t.name from teacher t join timetable_version v on v.id = t.version_id and v.active where t.key = ?", String.class, key));
    }

    @Test
    void candidatesFollowTheRules() throws Exception {
        // Period 3 on Friday
        String gap = fridayTeachers(ps -> !ps.isEmpty() && !ps.contains(3) && java.util.Collections.min(ps) < 3 && java.util.Collections.max(ps) > 3).getFirst();
        String rightAfter = fridayTeachers(ps -> !ps.isEmpty() && java.util.Collections.max(ps) == 2).getFirst();
        String rightBefore = fridayTeachers(ps -> !ps.isEmpty() && java.util.Collections.min(ps) == 4).getFirst();
        String teaching = fridayTeachers(ps -> ps.contains(3)).getFirst();
        String offDay = fridayTeachers(java.util.Set::isEmpty).getFirst();

        String body = mockMvc.perform(get("/days/{d}/candidates", FRI).param("period", "3").header("Authorization", bearer()))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[?(@.key=='" + gap + "')].status").value("FREE"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[?(@.key=='" + rightAfter + "')].status").value("FREE"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[?(@.key=='" + rightBefore + "')].status").value("ASK_FIRST"))
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[?(@.key=='" + teaching + "')]").isEmpty())
                .andExpect(jsonPath("$[?(@.key=='" + offDay + "')]").isEmpty())
                .andReturn().getResponse().getContentAsString();

        for (String tooLate : fridayTeachers(ps -> !ps.isEmpty() && java.util.Collections.min(ps) >= 5)) {
            org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat(body).doesNotContain("\"" + tooLate + "\"");
        }
        // Every FREE entry comes before every ASK_FIRST entry
        int lastFree = body.lastIndexOf("\"FREE\""), firstAsk = body.indexOf("\"ASK_FIRST\"");
        org.assertj.core.api.Assertions.assertThat(firstAsk == -1 || lastFree < firstAsk).isTrue();
    }
```

- [ ] **Step 2: API client** `src/api/client.ts`

```ts
const BASE = import.meta.env.VITE_API_URL
const TOKEN_KEY = 'asendus.token'

export const tokenStore = {
  get: () => localStorage.getItem(TOKEN_KEY),
  set: (t: string) => localStorage.setItem(TOKEN_KEY, t),
  clear: () => localStorage.removeItem(TOKEN_KEY),
}

export class ApiError extends Error {
  constructor(public status: number, message: string) { super(message) }
}

let onUnauthorized = () => {}
export const setUnauthorizedHandler = (fn: () => void) => { onUnauthorized = fn }

export async function api<T>(path: string, init: RequestInit = {}): Promise<T> {
  const headers = new Headers(init.headers)
  const token = tokenStore.get()
  if (token) headers.set('Authorization', `Bearer ${token}`)
  if (init.body && !(init.body instanceof FormData)) headers.set('Content-Type', 'application/json')

  const res = await fetch(BASE + path, { ...init, headers })
  if (res.status === 401) {
    tokenStore.clear()
    onUnauthorized()
  }
  if (!res.ok) {
    const body = await res.json().catch(() => null)
    throw new ApiError(res.status, body?.error ?? 'Midagi läks valesti')
  }
  return (res.status === 204 ? undefined : await res.json()) as T
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Types** `src/api/types.ts`: TS mirrors of every DTO from Tasks 7–8 (`TimetablePreview`, `TeacherSummary`, `TimetableSummary`, `Lesson`, `TeacherGrid`, `Substitution`, `Absence`, `Day`, `Candidate` with `status: 'FREE' | 'ASK_FIRST'`), plus `AuthResponse { token: string; user: { id: number; email: string; name: string } }`.

- [ ] **Step 4: Auth** `src/auth/AuthContext.tsx`

```tsx
import { createContext, useContext, useEffect, useState, type ReactNode } from 'react'
import { useNavigate } from 'react-router'
import { api, setUnauthorizedHandler, tokenStore } from '../api/client'
import type { AuthResponse } from '../api/types'

type Auth = { loggedIn: boolean; login: (idToken: string) => Promise<void>; logout: () => void }
const AuthContext = createContext<Auth | null>(null)

export function AuthProvider({ children }: { children: ReactNode }) {
  const [loggedIn, setLoggedIn] = useState(() => tokenStore.get() !== null)
  const navigate = useNavigate()

  useEffect(() => setUnauthorizedHandler(() => { setLoggedIn(false); navigate('/') }), [navigate])

  const login = async (idToken: string) => {
    const res = await api<AuthResponse>('/auth/google', { method: 'POST', body: JSON.stringify({ idToken }) })
    tokenStore.set(res.token)
    setLoggedIn(true)
  }
  const logout = () => { tokenStore.clear(); setLoggedIn(false); navigate('/') }

  return <AuthContext value={{ loggedIn, login, logout }}>{children}</AuthContext>
}

export function useAuth() {
  const ctx = useContext(AuthContext)
  if (!ctx) throw new Error('useAuth outside AuthProvider')
  return ctx
}
```

`src/auth/RequireAuth.tsx`: if `!loggedIn` → `<Navigate to="/" replace />`, else `<Outlet />`.

```tsx
import { GoogleLogin } from '@react-oauth/google'
import { Navigate, useNavigate } from 'react-router'
import { useAuth } from '../auth/AuthContext'
import { useToast } from '../components/Toast'
import { todayIso } from '../lib/dates'

export default function LandingPage() {
  const { loggedIn, login } = useAuth()
  const { showError } = useToast()
  const navigate = useNavigate()
  if (loggedIn) return <Navigate to={`/paev/${todayIso()}`} replace />

  return (
    <main className="mx-auto max-w-xl px-4 py-16">
      <h1 className="text-3xl font-semibold">Asendused</h1>
      <p className="mt-4 text-gray-700">
        Märgi puuduvad õpetajad ja vaata kohe, kes saab nende tunde asendada. Tunniplaan tuleb otse kooli PDF-ist
        ning päeva asenduste tabeli saad kopeerida Wordi või välja printida.
      </p>
      <ul className="mt-6 list-disc pl-5 text-gray-700">
        <li>Näeb, kes on igas tunnis vaba</li>
        <li>Arvestab, millal õpetaja koolis on</li>
        <li>Teeb asenduste tabeli valmis</li>
      </ul>
      <div className="mt-8">
        <GoogleLogin
          onSuccess={async ({ credential }) => {
            if (!credential) return
            try { await login(credential); navigate(`/paev/${todayIso()}`) }
            catch (e) { showError((e as Error).message) }
          }}
          onError={() => showError('Google sisselogimine ebaõnnestus')}
          text="signin_with"
          locale="et"
        />
      </div>
    </main>
  )
}
```

```ts
// dates.ts
const NAMES = ['Pühapäev', 'Esmaspäev', 'Teisipäev', 'Kolmapäev', 'Neljapäev', 'Reede', 'Laupäev']
const parse = (iso: string) => { const [y, m, d] = iso.split('-').map(Number); return new Date(y, m - 1, d) }

export const todayIso = () => { const d = new Date(); return `${d.getFullYear()}-${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}-${String(d.getDate()).padStart(2, '0')}` }
export const shortDate = (iso: string) => { const d = parse(iso); return `${d.getDate()}.${String(d.getMonth() + 1).padStart(2, '0')}` }
export const weekdayName = (iso: string) => NAMES[parse(iso).getDay()]
export const isWeekend = (iso: string) => [0, 6].includes(parse(iso).getDay())
```

- [ ] **Step 3: Implement** `dayTable.ts`

```ts
import type { Day } from '../api/types'
import { shortDate } from './dates'
import { subjectName } from './subjects'

export const HEADER = ['Kuupäev', 'Puuduva õpetaja nimi', 'Klass', 'Mitmes tund', 'Tunni asendaja nimi', 'Õppeaine']
export type TableRow = string[]

export function buildRows(day: Day): TableRow[] {
  const date = shortDate(day.date)
  return [...day.absences]
    .sort((a, b) => a.teacherName.localeCompare(b.teacherName, 'et'))
    .flatMap(a => [...a.rows].sort((x, y) => x.period - y.period).map(r => [
      date, a.teacherName, r.classes, String(r.period),
      [r.substituteNames, r.freeText].filter(Boolean).join(' / '),
      subjectName(r.subject),
    ]))
}

const esc = (s: string) => s.replace(/&/g, '&amp;').replace(/</g, '&lt;').replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
const cell = 'border:1px solid #000;padding:4px 8px'

export function toHtml(rows: TableRow[]): string {
  const head = HEADER.map(h => `<th style="${cell}">${esc(h)}</th>`).join('')
  const body = rows.map(r => `<tr>${r.map(c => `<td style="${cell}">${esc(c)}</td>`).join('')}</tr>`).join('')
  return `<table style="border-collapse:collapse"><thead><tr>${head}</tr></thead><tbody>${body}</tbody></table>`
}

export const toPlainText = (rows: TableRow[]) => [HEADER, ...rows].map(r => r.join('\t')).join('\n')

export async function copyTable(rows: TableRow[]) {
  await navigator.clipboard.write([new ClipboardItem({
    'text/html': new Blob([toHtml(rows)], { type: 'text/html' }),
    'text/plain': new Blob([toPlainText(rows)], { type: 'text/plain' }),
  })])
}
```
